title: Step 1 of the launch: a name, one line and one link make a free Space and publish its Space Spotlight

source.ref: Vera guided launch system, VLS-07. Every Get a Free Spotlight button (VLS-05) lands on /launch/start.

verify.cmd: npx vitest run lib/launch/spotlight-step.test.ts && node scripts/probes/launch-spotlight.mjs
verify.note: The answers, the handle and the published Spotlight preferences are pinned by the vitest file; the probe reads the wiring: dark while LAUNCH_SYSTEM_ENABLED is off, /launch/start asks for no account, a signed-out Publish holds the answers and sends the visitor to sign in, a signed-in one makes the Space through the shared provisioning (createSpace and the launch run one function) and records the step, and a second Publish reuses the Space. Fails on main, where none of it exists.

detail: GET /launch/start (from every Get a Free Spotlight button) holds a visitor in the launch cookie, or starts a signed-in member's launch, and lands on /launch/step/spotlight. The form asks for a name, one line in the person's own words, and an optional https link. Publish signed out holds the answers and sends the visitor to sign in (claim keeps held answers until this step publishes, so signing in loses nothing); signed in it makes the free Space (createSpaceForLaunch: the same provisioning createSpace runs, now without the redirect; handle from the name, retried with a suffix when taken), writes and publishes the Space Spotlight as heading, text and the link, marks the step published, and lands on the public Spotlight. The Spotlight is exactly what the person typed. Not here: a theme kit choice and the member profile Spotlight theme (opts.spotlight), the step frame and published screen (VLS-09), the live preview frame. The system stays switched off until the remaining steps and the published screen land.
